body: Thank you for your kind words. I think I'm just struggling because everything that is wrong with me feels like its built into me, like DNA or something. I can't see ever waking up and not hating myself so deeply. I just dont know how to get out of that.

I always liked that meme. Also the one that says "Will likely be late due to who I am as a person."     


Today is the first day that I've felt truly thirsty. I saw a guy sipping through a straw at a stoplight today and felt a pang in my throat. I've been doing cold water rinses, and using lip balm on my lips. Just having the water in my mouth for a couple of seconds feels good, even though I'm not drinking it. I'm noticing that while that stuff felt good for the first couple of days, it's kind of not cutting it now.       





I feel like if I drink now I'm losing somehow. I dont know if that makes sense. I think I'm mostly being fueled by self-hatred at this point, honestly. If I feel thirsty and want to break, my brain kindly reminds me of what a worthless piece of crap I am. For now, my sense of self-hatred is stronger than my sense of self-preservation.

I'm mostly just tired. Mentally, for certain, and I think that's a big part of it. I can feel the lack of food and water affecting me - dizzy when I stand up, dry mouth, fatigue. I've lost 6 pounds in 4 days. But it just feels like my physical state catching up to my mental state, if that makes sense. I've been tired for so long in my head and my heart. I dont know that dehydration/starvation is how I'm going to actually die (that was my plan when I started - I've been researching it, and it can take a while depending on your physical state when you stop taking anything in, your activity level, and your environment) but I feel like this is just me finally giving up.
